_comment: ASZDA plans and credit packages: the single source of truth for prices.
Prices are integer US cents (900 = $9.00). The web app and checkout read them from here via the API.
monthly_credits / credits: how many ASZDA credits each purchase gives. These are founder decisions;
null means 'not decided yet' and that item cannot be bought until a number is set.
paystack_plan_code: the PLN_... code of the matching monthly USD plan created in the Paystack dashboard.
null means that plan cannot be subscribed to yet. See docs/BILLING.md.
